claims.claim_ar: تأخير بيان الفاعل: وجود ضمير متصل في الفعل (يُبَشِّرُهُمْ) ثم بيان الفاعل لاحقاً بـ«رَبُّهُمْ» كوسيلة بلاغية للتوكيد
claims.claim_en: Delay (takhir) of the explicit subject: the verb contains a suffixed pronoun (يُبَشِّرُهُمْ) and the subject is then stated explicitly as «رَبُّهُمْ», a rhetorical device that emphasizes the subject (divine agency).
claims.needs_review_reason: Source chunks are grammatical iʿrāb notes (not tafsīr/بلاغة); the identification of emphasis via postposed explicit subject is an inference from syntax and should be checked against classical rhetorical commentary.

claims.claim_ar: سجع/إيقاع بلاغي في نهاية العبارة: تآلف صوتي ونغمي (نَعِيمٌ مُّقِيمٌ) يعزز الإحكام اللفظي والوقعي
claims.claim_en: Saj (rhythmic/phonic harmony): the phonetic pairing at the end (نَعِيمٌ مُّقِيمٌ) creates a rhymed/sonorous effect that reinforces the verbal and emotive closure.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunks comment on verbal/structural neatness but do not present explicit badiʿ (saj) analysis for this ayah; confirm with dedicated balāgha sources.

claims.claim_ar: تراكم وترتيب نعوت النعيم («بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَرِضْوَانٍ وَجَنَّاتٍ») كتدريجٍ وصنعة بلاغية لزيادة الأثر والبهجة
claims.claim_en: Stylistic/wise arrangement (asloob hakim): the accumulation and ordering of blessings (mercy, approval, gardens) forms a graded listing intended to increase emotive impact and delight.
claims.needs_review_reason: Claim based on general remark about careful ordering in the provided chunk; requires verification against tafsīr balāgha and rhetoricians (al-Jurjānī, al-Sakkākī, etc.).
